reviewDecisions: Only 3 fixed 2024 HS2022/871160 export records; preserve world totals and bilateral observations separately.

HS871160 is an aggregate related category; export route connections remain representative, curated and unmeasured. Exact reported values stay exclusively in tradeObservations, separate from product supply-chain structure.
Ningxia inventory notice is a definition and survey request, not proof of operating factories.
PDF pages 28–29 and 34–35 reviewed: assembly of purchased finished components; installed battery mount excludes cells; test battery removed; battery and charger separately packed.
Battery manufacturing and downstream recycling technology are incomplete; only representative functional layers shown.
Product and input descriptions explain function and use; scope restrictions remain in limitations and evidence metadata.
